title: Working With the Spell Check System and Dictionary in 4Dv14
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Mac OS X native spell check integration

historical_commentary.text: The switch from the Cordial to the Hunspell dictionary engine in v14 was a significant, still-standing architectural change; Hunspell remains 4D's spell-check backend in current versions, so this note's dictionary-location and customization guidance is largely still applicable, aside from any incremental changes to file paths/formats in much newer releases.
related_updates: Hunspell continues as 4D's dictionary engine in subsequent versions, though file locations/details may have shifted slightly since v14
